simple.meaning: שָׁנָה (shânâh) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to fold , i.e. duplicate (literally or figuratively); by implication, to transmute (transitive or intransitive).” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 22 times across Genesis, 1 Samuel, 2 Samuel, 1 Kings, Nehemiah, and 6 more, beginning at Genesis 41:32. Its contexts include family, family line, death, kingship, prophetic witness.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שָׁנָה (H8138).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: שָׁנָה (shânâh) / H8138 is traced through Genesis 41:32, 1 Samuel 21:14, 1 Samuel 26:8, 2 Samuel 20:10 as a generated source-based concept entry.

occurrences.englishText: The dream was doubled to Pharaoh, because the thing is established by God, and God will shortly bring it to pass.
Then Achish said to his servants, “Look, you see the man is insane. Why then have you brought him to me?

Then Abishai said to David, “God has delivered up your enemy into your hand today. Now therefore please let me strike him with the spear to the earth at one stroke, and I will not strike him the second time.”

But Amasa took no heed to the sword that was in Joab’s hand. So he struck him with it in the body, and shed out his bowels to the ground, and didn’t strike him again; and he died. Joab and Abishai his brother pursued Sheba the son of Bichri.

Jeroboam said to his wife, “Please get up and disguise yourself, so that you won’t be recognized as Jeroboam’s wife. Go to Shiloh. Behold, Ahijah the prophet is there, who said that I would be king over this people.
He said, “Do it a second time;” and they did it the second time. He said, “Do it a third time;” and they did it the third time.
He said, “Do it a second time;” and they did it the second time. He said, “Do it a third time;” and they did it the third time.
Then I testified against them, and said to them, “Why do you stay around the wall? If you do so again, I will lay hands on you.” From that time on, they didn’t come on the Sabbath.
They gave them drinks in golden vessels of various kinds, including royal wine in abundance, according to the bounty of the king.

The maiden pleased him, and she obtained kindness from him. He quickly gave her cosmetics and her portions of food, and the seven choice maidens who were to be given her out of the king’s house. He moved her and her maidens to the best place in the women’s house.

Haman said to King Ahasuerus, “There is a certain people scattered abroad and dispersed among the peoples in all the provinces of your kingdom, and their laws are different from other people’s. They don’t keep the king’s laws. Therefore it is not for the king’s profit to allow them to remain.
You forever prevail against him, and he departs.
After my words they didn’t speak again.

Once I have sworn by my holiness,
He who covers an offense promotes love;
My son, fear Yahweh and the king.
As a dog that returns to his vomit,
lest they drink, and forget the law,
Why do you go about so much to change your ways?
and changed his prison garments. Jehoiachin ate bread before him continually all the days of his life.
“For I, Yahweh, don’t change; therefore you, sons of Jacob, are not consumed.
